scope: All six frozen first-pass candidate sessions; structured dataflow inspection responses.
method: For each inspection, extract top-level def names from its returned inspection strings and compare with def names in recorded input messages containing the selected exact definitions at task start heading. Separately restrict to functions available in the previous turn workflow, excluding branch and historical-reader operators as workflowFunctions does, so newly created functions are not mistaken for history retrieval misses. Deduplicate function names within each call; repeated calls remain separate observations.
limitations: Declaration names only; this does not establish body equality.
Only the selected task-start memory is searched; a definition might appear elsewhere in the active prompt.
A table inspection also returns bindings and revision metadata, which may justify it even if its function declaration was already selected.
This is descriptive coverage of executed inspections; it does not measure retrieval quality for all requested tasks or establish a causal effect on scores.
